reason: Goal agents can open typed operator action requests. Docs: butler-supervisor-powers and nebula-settings-assistant; product knowledge rebuilt. Python selects the new suite, the operator action and model-refusal suites (default notifier), the Claude adapter suite, harness chat goal and provider goal-tool suites (test_butler_oversight, test_turn_tool_bookkeeping), five gateway/goal node ids in test_harnesses, and four product-knowledge nodes.
